title: Why does vocal separation fail?
caption:
One question: how do time-frequency overlap and mixture-phase mismatch relate to vocal reconstruction errors?

We reproduce oracle baselines, make a small phase-sensitive modification, and compare UMXHQ with HTDemucs.

Captioned demonstration with real local execution and music examples.

caption: 5 official test tracks; 9 active excerpts; 36 paired inputs. Same stems and exact inputs for every method.

title: What can we conclude?
caption:
Exact target magnitude is not automatically the best reconstruction when phase is wrong.

Gain changes move overlap and phase mismatch together; their independent causes are not isolated.

Five tracks, short excerpts, unequal model training data and no formal listening study limit generalization.
